messages:
kai_ci: heads-up — PR gating started failing intermittently on quantized eval shards this morning. GH Actions jobs hit the 45m worker timeout and never upload artifacts.

sara_ml: saw that, reproduced locally. long matrix rows (q4_0, q4_k_dq, q8) push a shard to ~30-40m, then the runner loses auth when uploading. error is `401` from our artifact service.

ben_platform: is this the same token-rotate issue from last quarter? runners using ephemeral GH PATs, they expire during long runs.

kai_ci: looks like it. logs show "token expired" right before curl upload. here's the upload command in the GH step:```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.EVAL_UPLOAD_TOKEN }}" -F file=@result.tar.gz https://artifacts.redwood-inference.internal/upload
```

amy_sre: +1. options: 1) switch heavy quant variants off PR matrix and run them on nightly Buildkite shards, 2) refresh token before upload as a retry, 3) split shard into smaller jobs. prefer option 1 for infra cost stability.

sara_ml: splitting helps but explodes CI runtime. we need a pragmatic immediate fix for PRs so devs don't wait. can we make PR gate run a smoke subset (short tests + correctness checks) and queue full quant benchmarking to nightly?

ben_platform: we already have a `smoke` label in the eval harness. simplest: update .github/workflows/eval-pr.yml to run matrix filtered by `fast=true` for PRs, full matrix for `workflow_dispatch` and nightly. example snippet:```yaml
on: [pull_request, schedule, workflow_dispatch]
jobs:
  eval:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        variant: [base, q4_0, q8, q4_k_dq]
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && matrix.variant == 'base' # only run base on PRs
```

kai_ci: that works. also need to ensure artifact upload uses a short-lived token refresh loop to avoid mid-upload expiry. I'll add a helper that fetches a fresh token just before upload step.

amy_sre: also tweak schedule to add jitter so nightly shard runner pool doesn't spike at 00:00 UTC:```
cron: '0 3 * * *' # existing
# add ±10m random jitter in the runner script
```

deploy-bot: Incident created: #INC-2025-047 - PR gating flakes for quant evals. Assigned to kai_ci, sara_ml. :alarm_clock:

ben_platform: for longer term: move very long quantization full-eval to Dedicated Buildkite pools with pre-warmed cache and OIDC token refresh. GH Actions stays for fast feedback.

sara_ml: agreed. I'll open a PR to change GH workflow to smoke-on-PR + nightly full-matrix, and add a small retry wrapper for artifact upload. will ping ops for a Buildkite ticket.

kai_ci: thanks — I'll prototype the token-refresh helper and a matrix gating rule. planning to cut the PR today.

amy_sre: once PR lands, we'll monitor the nightly backlog and add alerts for orphaned shards. :mag:

ben_platform: small note — add a visible label in PR checks like `eval:smoke` so authors know what ran.

kai_ci: good call. will add check-run text.

sara_ml: tagging the quant owners after merge to watch for quality regressions. :white_check_mark:

ami_sre: (typo — amy_sre)

kai_ci: :laughing:, fixed.

sara_ml: ok pushing PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/842

ben_platform: nice. once merged let's coordinate a manual run of the Buildkite full-quant job to warm caches.

kai_ci: done, closing this thread when PR merges.
